title: Somatic cell reprogramming using NF-κB inhibitory strategies
protocol: Transfect retroviral vectors expressing human OCT4, SOX2, KLF4 and c-MYC in HEK-293T cells along with packaging plasmids to produce retrovirus.
Seed human primary fibroblasts at a density of 1x10^5 cells per well in 6-well plates.
Infect cells with retroviral supernatants 24 hours after plating, repeating the procedure every 12 hours for two days (total four additions).
Replace medium with fibroblast medium on day three post last infection and add NF-κB inhibitors at this point (IKK-VII, 0.5 µM and sodium salicylate, 0.2 mM).
Trypsinize cells at day seven and reseed them onto feeder plates.
Change the medium to human iPSC medium on day eight.
Maintain cultures with daily medium changes for four weeks.
Isolate colonies from the culture and expand them on a feeder layer or stain them with Tra-1-60 for evaluating reprogramming efficiency.
Seed human primary fibroblasts at a density of 1x10^5 cells per well in 6-well plates.
Infect the seeded cells with retroviral supernatants 24 hours after plating.
Repeat infection procedure every 12 hours for two days (a total of four additions).
Trypsinize the cells at day 7 and reseed them on feeder plates.
Change the medium to human iPSC medium on day 8.
Maintain cultures with daily medium changes for four weeks.
